facts.text: Jon's dance crew won first place in a local competition last year, and he is eager to share that intensity with others.

evidence.quote: Woah, that pic's from when my dance crew took home first in a local comp last year. It was amazing up on that stage! I'm super keen to spread that intensity with other peeps.

facts.text: Gina competed in dance competitions and shows, with a favorite memory of winning first place at a regionals at age fifteen.

evidence.quote: I used to compete in a few dance competitions and shows - my fav memory was when my team won first place at a regionals at age fifteen. It was an awesome feeling of accomplishment!

facts.text: Gina's team performed a contemporary dance piece called 'Finding Freedom', which was emotional and powerful.

evidence.quote: We just did a contemporary piece called 'Finding Freedom.' It was really emotional and powerful.
